role: COPY #2 of NFTStaker. Byte-for-byte identical EXCEPT immutable priceScale multiplier normalizing dispatcher prime-token decimals into phUSD (18dp). Deployed for NudgeRatchet (6dp USDC) dispatcher. priceScale==1 => identical to base.
intendedDeltasVsBase: single line in _recomputeSchedule: latestPrice = latestPrice * priceScale; (bare multiply, AFTER the latestPrice recovery, BEFORE S computation)
divergenceVerified: Confirmed byte-identical to NFTStaker.sol on ALL shared logic (_syncBudget ALWAYS recomputes when hook set / recomputes on no-hook; stake+unstake TAIL _recomputeSchedule present; _safePay inline msg.sender; emergencyWithdraw identical). ONLY the 3 intended deltas differ.

localFindings.description: priceScale magnitude is a deploy-time immutable footgun: wrong exponent silently scales S (and thus rewardRate) by 10^k. Known finding L-08 (run-17). Surfaced, not new.

interfaceAbstraction.note: Identical entrypoint/externalCall/valueMath surface to NFTStaker.json EXCEPT rewardRate math: S = totalStaked * (latestPrice * priceScale). Overflow bound: latestPrice(~1e21) * priceScale(<=1e12) * totalStaked(~1e6) ~ 1e39 << 2^256.
interfaceAbstraction.externalCalls: same as NFTStaker (IBalancerPoolerMintDebtHook hook, INFTSupply nftMinter, phUSD, ERC1155 stakedToken)

trustAssumptions: priceScale set correctly at deploy (immutable, unfixable post-deploy)
